title: Pennsylvania CCDBG — State-Edge Transaction Pilot
question: Can the April 17, 2025 CCDBG payment be joined to Pennsylvania receipt, SAP and PELICAN accounting, provider payment, correction and ACF-696 reporting?
bluf: The public payment joins to a real CCDBG award, and Pennsylvania documents a detailed PELICAN-to-SAP/provider accounting trail. Public evidence still does not join the federal payment to one State receipt, SAP journal, provider payment, correction or ACF-696 line. The gap is a cross-system identity and reconciliation problem, not proof that the downstream records do not exist.
